opening.argument: The video shows an operational BUSD withdrawal walkthrough. The wallet screen has a recipient address entered and the amount set to 5 BUSD, followed by a transfer review screen. Those visible steps support an instructional account of how to make a withdrawal, not a demonstrated deceptive promise, credential request, impersonation, or recruitment-dependent benefit. The review screen shows the proposed transfer, but the supplied material does not establish that the transaction was completed or that the destination was deceptive. The evidence supports a demonstration of the wallet process, with the outcome and destination left unverified.
